Early blight

Dark rings on the older, lower leaves. Common, and treatable.
Do these first, no spraying
1
Pull off the worst leaves and burn them. Do not leave them lying in the field.
2
Water the soil, not the leaves.
3
Give the rows room so leaves dry quickly after rain.
